Alan Franco.note: Franco has been one of Ecuador's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Alan Franco.noteZh: 他是Ecuador这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Alan Minda.note: Minda is attacking depth for Ecuador. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Alan Minda.noteZh: 他是Ecuador前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Angelo Preciado.note: Preciado is the kind of defender Ecuador can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Angelo Preciado.noteZh: 他是Ecuador艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Anthony Valencia.note: Valencia is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Ecuador, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Anthony Valencia.noteZh: 他给Ecuador提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Denil Castillo.note: Castillo gives Ecuador a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Denil Castillo.noteZh: 他是Ecuador的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Enner Valencia.note: Valencia gives Ecuador a route when possession needs to become pressure. He is there to make a defender choose.
Enner Valencia.noteZh: 他是Ecuador这届赛事中被重点使用的进攻路线之一。他先让第一名防守者移动，再让终结或最后一传出现。

Felix Torres.note: Torres is back-line insurance for Ecuador. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Felix Torres.noteZh: 他给Ecuador那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Gonzalo Plata.note: Plata is on the scoresheet for Ecuador, with his goal coming against Germany. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Gonzalo Plata.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Gonzalo Valle.note: Valle gives Ecuador a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Gonzalo Valle.noteZh: 他在Ecuador首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Hernan Galindez.note: Galíndez has been Ecuador's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Hernan Galindez.noteZh: 他给Ecuador提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Jackson Porozo.note: Porozo gives Ecuador cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Jackson Porozo.noteZh: 他是Ecuador后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jeremy Arevalo.note: Arévalo is an attacking change-up for Ecuador. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Jeremy Arevalo.noteZh: 他是Ecuador的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Joel Ordonez.note: Ordóñez has been part of Ecuador's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Joel Ordonez.noteZh: 他在Ecuador体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

John Yeboah.note: Yeboah has been part of Ecuador's front-line plan. He stretches defenders first, then looks for the touch that turns pressure into a chance.
John Yeboah.noteZh: 他是Ecuador前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Jordy Alcivar.note: Alcívar gives Ecuador cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Jordy Alcivar.noteZh: 他是Ecuador后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jordy Caicedo.note: Caicedo is an attacking change-up for Ecuador. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Jordy Caicedo.noteZh: 他是Ecuador的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Kendry Paez.note: Páez gives Ecuador a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Kendry Paez.noteZh: 他是Ecuador的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Kevin Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez has supplied one of Ecuador's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Kevin Rodriguez.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Ecuador创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Moises Caicedo.note: Caicedo is a tempo player for Ecuador. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Moises Caicedo.noteZh: 他让Ecuador在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Moises Ramirez.note: Ramírez is Ecuador's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Moises Ramirez.noteZh: 他是Ecuador的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Nilson Angulo.note: Angulo has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Germany. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Nilson Angulo.noteZh: 他已经为Ecuador进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Pedro Vite.note: Vite has supplied one of Ecuador's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Pedro Vite.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Ecuador创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Pervis Estupinan.note: Estupiñán gives Ecuador cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Pervis Estupinan.noteZh: 他是Ecuador后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Piero Hincapie.note: Hincapié has been part of Ecuador's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Piero Hincapie.noteZh: 他给Ecuador后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Willian Pacho.note: Pacho gives Ecuador one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Willian Pacho.noteZh: 他是Ecuador无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Yaimar Medina.note: Medina gives Ecuador a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Yaimar Medina.noteZh: 他是Ecuador的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。
